summary.headline: Prognosis and Rhetorius’s Sowing
summary.text: Discussion of prognosis through medicine and astrology as an artful, conjectural practice, limited by customs, laws, places, education, providence, prayer, and heavenly causes. A section from Rhetorius explains sowing by dividing the zodiac into degrees and using the horoscope, conjunctions, and a right-angled triangle to predict gestation length.
